prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript module exporting `RosterPage`, `RosterEntry`, and `mergeRosterPages(pages)`. Each page has a non-negative integer `page`, a boolean `complete`, and readonly entries containing non-empty string `id` and `displayName`. Reject malformed page numbers, duplicate page numbers, or malformed entries with `TypeError`. Process pages by ascending page number regardless of input order. For each id, retain the display name from its first occurrence in that order and ignore later occurrences. Return `{entries, complete}` where entries preserve first-occurrence order and are fresh objects; `complete` is true only when at least one page was supplied and every page is complete. Empty input returns an empty list and false. Do not mutate or alias the input.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
